payload.title: M11 Wave 4: c1/14-17 flip the card, counting with lamps, inside the number, make-your-own-instruction, with G5
payload.description: Part of M11 (SIE-e8c918). c1/14-16 are the old draft lessons 06-08, renamed in the product repo. c1/17 encodes a word with lamps (D4 word target). Engine: G5. Overflow appears here as a planned surprise (side room).
